policies.reason: Current Rule 6 prohibits generative AI, with an exception only for disclosed translation of the contributor's own original writing. This does not permit an agent-written Bunko introduction, historical answer, or translation of another author's classic. Do not route around the restriction through private contact. Human-authored participation must independently satisfy all current rules.

Current Rule 1 excludes AI-generated resource posts and app content at moderator discretion. Rule 5 also excludes mostly paid resource self-promotion. Do not generate a creator introduction or route around these restrictions through private contact. Any human-authored participation must independently meet all current rules.

The full moderation policy disallows AI-composed content. The monthly Share Your Resources exception permits self-promotion but does not waive that authorship rule; outside it, product mentions need permission. Agent drafts and sends stay disabled, including for the monthly thread. Human-authored participation remains subject to the current promotion policy and six-month repeat interval.
Current r/forhire Rule 10 prohibits bots from contacting members for any purpose. Agent-authored applications, replies, and follow-ups are therefore manual-operator only.
Current r/hiring Rule 8 prohibits bots from contacting members for any purpose. Agent-authored applications, replies, and follow-ups are therefore manual-operator only.

Current r/3Dprinting community rules prohibit AI-generated content in any shape. Agent public replies are disabled. Agent private outreach from these requests is also disabled to avoid routing around the community restriction; human operator participation remains subject to its rules.

Current r/selfhosted rules allow relevant, useful project mentions in comments but prohibit spam and excessive self-promotion. Public replies must solve the self-hosting question first, use at most one disclosed project reference, and never initiate private contact.
